For research collaboration, manuscript discussion, quantitative analysis, teaching, or professional exchange in marine ecology and fisheries science, use the contact details below.

## Areas of collaboration

- quantitative marine ecology and fisheries science;
- stock assessment, population dynamics, selectivity, recruitment, growth, and life-history variation;
- spatio-temporal, habitat, and species-distribution modelling;
- environmental variability, ecosystem responses, and Eastern Boundary Upwelling Systems;
- multivariate stock-state indicators, thresholds, regime shifts, and pressure–state relationships;
- management strategy evaluation, adaptive fisheries management, and decision-support methods;
- fisheries-dependent, acoustic, biological, and oceanographic data integration;
- statistical modelling and reproducible workflows in R, Python, C++, Julia, Git, and GitHub;
- scientific software, marine data workflows, workshops, and teaching activities;
- conference, symposium, seminar, and collaborative research invitations.

## When contacting me

A concise first message is usually sufficient. For research or technical collaboration, it is useful to include the scientific question, available data or expected data source, intended output, and approximate timeline.

For projects involving confidential, restricted, or institutionally governed data, please describe the access conditions first rather than attaching sensitive data to the initial message.
